preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string s must be small Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(all(s[i] == s[i + p] for i in range(0, len(s) - p, p)) for p in range(2, len(s) + 1) if is_prime(p)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: If it is possible to rearrange the characters to satisfy the condition for any prime p, output 'YES' followed by a valid rearranged string; otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and len(stdout.splitlines()[1]) == len(s)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the second line must contain a rearranged string of the same length as the input string.
